offline_population: admitted dev/test fixed pair manifests and sampled negative flags
matching: identical image goal, RGB history cadence, preprocessing, camera readbacks
identical qualified controller, action normalization unit and velocity limits
identical starts, obstacles, lighting, timeout and observer
frozen checkpoint digests and paired episode seeds

metrics.waypoint_error: masked valid action pairs; mean Euclidean waypoint distance in metres
metrics.navigation_arrival: collision-free entry within0.5m of goal; report separately from terminal success
metrics.correct_stopping: policy terminal action within0.5m; baseline native stopping unavailable
metrics.premature_stopping: policy terminal action outside0.5m; report stop and episode denominators
metrics.collisions: all attempted episodes; deliberate-contact and noncontact detector controls required
metrics.full_loop_latency: RGB available through preprocessing, inference, controller and motor-command submission; synchronized CUDA; acquisition timestamp tracked separately
